items.title: Dysfunction of the blood-brain barrier and neurovascular unit in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis - From advanced human models to treatments.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disorder, characterized by the degeneration of motor neurons, resulting in progressive and eventually complete loss of motor function. The phenotypical heterogeneity of ALS poses a challenge to early diagnosis and treatment, with currently available therapeutics only capable of relieving symptoms and slowing progression. While ALS is classified as a motor neuron disease (MND), research has identified significant impairment to the blood-brain barrier (BBB) and neurovascular unit (NVU) of ALS patients. The BBB along with supporting cells of the NVU selectively control the entry of substances into the central nervous system (CNS) and maintain brain homeostasis, with its many cellular components demonstrating impaired function, specifically relating to inflammation, oxidative stress and TDP-43 proteinopathy. The advent of more advanced in vitro techniques as well as use of patient-derived BBB cells has presented a promising alternative to recreate the in vivo structure of the BBB/NVU in a highly controlled platform. Such approaches have ranged from simple 2-dimensional (2D) cell culture to intricate 3-dimensional (3D) co-culture systems, as well as microfluidic systems and organoids, with a potential to investigate ALS associated BBB/NVU dysfunction and drug discovery. This review provides a comprehensive assessment of known BBB/NVU dysfunction in ALS and methods of investigating this using in vitro and in vivo platforms with a focus on inflammation, oxidative stress and pathological TDP-43 expression. This review also presents a future perspective to overcoming barriers to treatment of ALS using new patient-derived BBB/NVU model systems.
items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化中血脑屏障与神经血管单元的功能障碍——从先进人类模型到治疗
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述，系统梳理了ALS中血脑屏障和神经血管单元的功能障碍，涉及炎症、氧化应激和TDP-43蛋白病变等机制。文章重点介绍了从2D培养到3D共培养、微流控和类器官等先进体外模型，以及患者来源BBB细胞在模拟ALS病理和药物筛选中的应用潜力。作者认为，这些新型人类模型有望帮助克服ALS治疗开发中的障碍。
items.insight: 该综述将ALS的病理视野从运动神经元本身扩展到血脑屏障和神经血管单元，并系统盘点了患者来源BBB/NVU模型这一新兴工具链。对ALS研究者而言，其价值在于：一方面提示BBB/NVU功能障碍可能是被低估的疾病机制和治疗靶点，另一方面为构建更贴近人类生理的体外筛选平台提供了方法学参考，有助于推动药物发现和转化研究。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致死性神经退行性疾病，以运动神经元变性为特征，导致运动功能进行性并最终完全丧失。ALS的表型异质性给早期诊断和治疗带来挑战，目前可用的治疗手段仅能缓解症状并延缓进展。尽管ALS被归类为运动神经元病（MND），研究已发现ALS患者的血脑屏障（BBB）和神经血管单元（NVU）存在显著损伤。BBB连同NVU的支持细胞选择性控制物质进入中枢神经系统（CNS）并维持脑内稳态，其多种细胞组分表现出功能受损，具体涉及炎症、氧化应激和TDP-43蛋白病变。更先进的体外技术以及患者来源BBB细胞的应用，为在高度可控的平台上重建BBB/NVU的体内结构提供了有前景的替代方案。此类方法从简单的二维（2D）细胞培养到复杂的三维（3D）共培养系统，以及微流控系统和类器官，具有研究ALS相关BBB/NVU功能障碍和药物发现的潜力。本综述全面评估了ALS中已知的BBB/NVU功能障碍，以及利用体外和体内平台研究这一问题的方法，重点关注炎症、氧化应激和病理性TDP-43表达。本综述还提出了利用新的患者来源BBB/NVU模型系统克服ALS治疗障碍的未来展望。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述聚焦ALS中血脑屏障与神经血管单元功能障碍这一新近受关注的领域，并强调患者来源先进人类模型在机制研究和药物发现中的转化价值。

items.title: The thymus gland is a target and maintainer of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis pathophysiology.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disease characterized by the selective loss of motor neurons in the brain and spinal cord with evidence of local neuroinflammation. Regulatory T cells (Treg) exert neuroprotective effects and correlate with disease progression, but central mechanisms governing Treg development during ALS remain unclear. We investigated the thymic architecture and T cell differentiation in SOD1-G93A (mSOD1) ALS mice at multiple disease stages. Thymocyte and thymic epithelial cells (TEC) subpopulations, as well as stages of Treg differentiation and suppressive capacity, were analyzed by flow cytometry, in situ immunofluorescence, and functional assays. At late disease stage (120 days-old), mSOD1 mice displayed thymic atrophy, reduced thymocyte numbers, and decreased double-positive (DP), CD4 single-positive (SP), and Treg populations. Foxp3 expression per cell was preserved, but Treg progenitors and mature Treg numbers declined, paralleled by reduced suppressive function in vitro . TEC analysis revealed reduced total and mature medullary TEC (CD80 high MHCII high ), despite preserved Aire expression. Foxp3 + cells were abnormally localized at cortical sites, away from mTEC, associated with migratory abnormalities and increased apoptosis. TREC evaluation revealed reduced intrathymic sjTREC, consistent with impaired proliferation and differentiation between DN and DP stages, although peripheral sj/βTREC ratios remained stable. Reduced Treg numbers were also observed in lymph nodes draining affected hindlimbs. Our findings identify the thymus as a target organ in ALS, where thymic involution, TEC loss, and Treg dysfunction may compromise immune tolerance. These alterations likely reinforce the role of the thymus in peripheral immune dysregulation and neuroinflammation observed in ALS.
items.titleZh: 胸腺是肌萎缩侧索硬化病理生理学的靶标和维持者
items.summaryZh: 该研究在SOD1-G93A ALS小鼠模型中发现，疾病晚期胸腺出现萎缩、胸腺上皮细胞丢失和Treg发育及功能受损，提示胸腺可能是ALS免疫失调的重要环节。
items.insight: 这项研究将ALS的免疫机制从外周神经炎症拓展至中枢免疫器官胸腺，揭示了Treg发育受损的上游原因，为靶向胸腺-免疫轴的治疗策略提供了临床前依据，值得关注其向人类ALS验证的转化潜力。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致死性神经退行性疾病，其特征是脑和脊髓中运动神经元的选择性丢失，并伴有局部神经炎症的证据。调节性T细胞（Treg）发挥神经保护作用并与疾病进展相关，但ALS期间调控Treg发育的中枢机制仍不清楚。我们在多个疾病阶段研究了SOD1-G93A（mSOD1）ALS小鼠的胸腺结构和T细胞分化。通过流式细胞术、原位免疫荧光和功能测定，分析了胸腺细胞和胸腺上皮细胞（TEC）亚群，以及Treg分化和抑制能力的各个阶段。在疾病晚期（120日龄），mSOD1小鼠表现出胸腺萎缩、胸腺细胞数量减少，以及双阳性（DP）、CD4单阳性（SP）和Treg群体减少。每个细胞的Foxp3表达得以保留，但Treg祖细胞和成熟Treg数量下降，同时体外抑制功能降低。TEC分析显示总TEC和成熟髓质TEC（CD80高MHCII高）减少，尽管Aire表达得以保留。Foxp3+细胞异常定位于皮质部位，远离mTEC，与迁移异常和凋亡增加相关。TREC评估显示胸腺内sjTREC减少，与DN和DP阶段之间的增殖和分化受损一致，尽管外周sj/βTREC比值保持稳定。在引流受累后肢的淋巴结中也观察到Treg数量减少。我们的发现确定胸腺是ALS的靶器官，其中胸腺退化、TEC丢失和Treg功能障碍可能损害免疫耐受。这些改变可能强化了胸腺在ALS中观察到的外周免疫失调和神经炎症中的作用。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近揭示了胸腺作为ALS免疫失调上游靶器官的作用，为理解Treg功能障碍和神经炎症提供了新的转化研究方向。

items.title: Repairing the Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Trial Credibility Gap.
items.summary: There is a long history of early- and mid-phase amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) clinical trial data being used to make claims of clinical benefit that fail to translate into successful phase 3 outcomes. It is suggested that fallacious scientific reasoning is being encouraged by perverse incentives arising from a "clinical trial industrial complex" that greatly influences trial design, data interpretation, and results communication. Recurring fallacies include false premises underlying outcome comparisons, misuse and incorrect interpretation of biomarkers, mismatches between study design and stated objectives, selective reporting of outcomes, over-reliance on post hoc analyses and open-label extension data, and overly optimistic framing of inconclusive data. We argue that these practices, reinforced by misaligned incentives across industry and academia, lead to premature claims of therapeutic promise and tangible harm to patients. To address the resulting ALS clinical trial credibility gap, we call for rigorous adherence to established standards for reporting clinical trial results, clearer distinction between hypothesis generation and hypothesis testing, more measured description of trial results, and more disciplined triage of phase 2 programs. A cultural shift toward scientific skepticism and methodological rigor is essential to accelerate the development of genuinely effective ALS therapies.

items.titleZh: 弥合肌萎缩侧索硬化症临床试验的可信度差距
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇发表于《Neurology》的观点文章，而非一项新试验。作者指出，ALS早期和中期临床试验常被用来宣称疗效，但很少能在3期得到验证，原因包括结局比较前提错误、生物标志物误用、设计与目标不匹配、选择性报告、过度依赖事后分析和开放标签扩展数据，以及对不确定结果的乐观包装。作者认为，产业界与学术界激励错位助长了这些问题，导致过早宣称治疗前景并伤害患者。文章呼吁严格遵循报告标准、区分假设生成与假设检验、审慎描述结果，并对2期项目进行更严格的分流。
items.insight: 对ALS研究者而言，这篇文章的价值不在于提供新靶点或新数据，而在于提醒如何解读和设计早期试验。它直接点名了生物标志物（如NfL等）被误用、开放标签扩展数据被过度解读、事后分析被当作确证证据等常见问题。这些正是当前ALS试验报告和2期向3期推进决策中的核心争议点。若研究者、申办方和期刊能采纳文中建议，可能减少无效3期试验，优化有限患者资源的分配，并提高真正有效疗法被验证的概率。

items.abstractZh: 长期以来，肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）早期和中期临床试验数据被用来宣称临床获益，但这些宣称未能转化为成功的3期试验结果。文章指出，一个对试验设计、数据解读和结果传播具有重大影响的“临床试验工业复合体”所产生的扭曲激励，正在助长错误的科学推理。反复出现的谬误包括：结局比较所依据的错误前提、生物标志物的误用和错误解读、研究设计与既定目标之间的不匹配、结局的选择性报告、对事后分析和开放标签扩展数据的过度依赖，以及对无定论数据的过度乐观表述。我们认为，这些做法在产业界和学术界激励错位的强化下，导致对治疗前景的过早宣称，并对患者造成实际伤害。为弥合由此产生的ALS临床试验可信度差距，我们呼吁严格遵循既有的临床试验结果报告标准，更清晰地区分假设生成与假设检验，更审慎地描述试验结果，并对2期项目进行更有纪律的分流。向科学怀疑精神和方法学严谨性的文化转变，对于加速开发真正有效的ALS疗法至关重要。
items.frontierRationale: 该文于2026年发表，直面ALS临床试验可信度危机，提出方法学和报告规范层面的改革方向，对加速真正有效疗法的转化具有直接价值。

items.title: LRP12 CGG Repeat Expansions in Patients With Adult-Onset Non-5q Spinal Muscular Atrophy.
items.summary: Non-5q spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) is genetically heterogeneous, yet many adult-onset cases remain molecularly undiagnosed. CGG repeat expansions in the 5' untranslated region of LRP12 , originally identified in oculopharyngodistal myopathy, have also been implicated in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and inherited peripheral neuropathy. The aim of this study was to determine whether LRP12 CGG repeat expansions occur in patients with adult-onset proximal-predominant non-5q SMA and characterize the associated clinical presentations. In this observational case series, we enrolled 8 consecutive, genetically unresolved families that met prespecified criteria for adult-onset non-5q SMA after exclusion of known genetic causes of SMA and familial ALS by comprehensive genetic evaluation, including whole-exome sequencing. LRP12 CGG repeat expansions were screened by repeat-primed PCR and then confirmed and sized by Oxford Nanopore long-read sequencing. LRP12 CGG repeat expansions were also screened in 496 unrelated ALS cases and 1,000 controls. Monoallelic LRP12 CGG repeat expansions were identified in 6 of the 8 non-5q SMA probands (75%). Five of the 6 positive families were consistent with autosomal-dominant inheritance. Expanded alleles ranged from 58 to 92 repeat units. Affected individuals showed adult-onset, slowly progressive, proximal-predominant pure lower motor neuron weakness with preserved bulbar and sensory function and no upper motor neuron signs. Expansions were rare in ALS cases (2/496, 0.40%) and controls (2/1,000, 0.20%). We identified LRP12 CGG repeat expansions in a substantial proportion of patients with slowly progressive, proximal-predominant pure lower motor neuron weakness not linked to 5q-SMA. These findings broaden the clinical spectrum of LRP12 -related disease and support inclusion of LRP12 repeat-expansion analysis in the evaluation of genetically unresolved adult-onset lower motor neuron syndromes.
items.titleZh: 成人起病非5q型脊髓性肌萎缩症患者中的LRP12 CGG重复扩增
items.summaryZh: 这项观察性病例系列研究在8个遗传学未明确的成人起病非5q型SMA家系中，发现6个家系（75%）携带LRP12基因CGG重复扩增，扩增范围为58至92个重复单位。患者表现为成人起病、缓慢进展、以近端为主的纯下运动神经元无力，延髓和感觉功能保留，无上运动神经元体征。该扩增在ALS病例和对照中均较罕见。研究提示，LRP12重复扩增分析应纳入遗传学未明确的成人起病下运动神经元综合征的评估。
items.insight: 该研究将LRP12 CGG重复扩增从眼咽远端型肌病和ALS相关证据拓展到成人起病非5q型SMA表型，提示LRP12重复扩增是成人起病下运动神经元综合征中一个可被漏诊的遗传病因。对ALS研究者而言，其价值在于：一方面，LRP12相关疾病与ALS存在表型和遗传重叠，可能帮助解释部分“遗传学未明确”的运动神经元病病例；另一方面，该研究提供了重复扩增筛查与长读长测序确认的可行路径，值得在ALS及下运动神经元综合征队列中进一步验证。

items.abstractZh: 非5q型脊髓性肌萎缩症（SMA）具有遗传异质性，但许多成人起病病例在分子层面仍无法确诊。LRP12基因5'非翻译区的CGG重复扩增最初在眼咽远端型肌病中被发现，此后也被认为与肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）和遗传性周围神经病相关。本研究旨在确定成人起病、以近端为主的非5q型SMA患者中是否存在LRP12 CGG重复扩增，并描述其相关临床表现。在这项观察性病例系列研究中，我们连续入组了8个遗传学上未明确的家系，这些家系在通过包括全外显子组测序在内的全面遗传学评估排除已知SMA和家族性ALS遗传病因后，符合成人起病非5q型SMA的预设标准。LRP12 CGG重复扩增通过重复引物PCR进行筛查，随后通过Oxford Nanopore长读长测序进行确认和片段长度测定。同时还在496例无关ALS病例和1000例对照中筛查了LRP12 CGG重复扩增。在8例非5q型SMA先证者中，有6例（75%）检出单等位基因LRP12 CGG重复扩增。6个阳性家系中有5个符合常染色体显性遗传。扩增等位基因范围为58至92个重复单位。受累个体表现为成人起病、缓慢进展、以近端为主的纯下运动神经元无力，延髓和感觉功能保留，且无上运动神经元体征。该扩增在ALS病例中罕见（2/496，0.40%），在对照中亦罕见（2/1000，0.20%）。我们在相当比例的非5q-SMA相关、缓慢进展、以近端为主的纯下运动神经元无力患者中发现了LRP12 CGG重复扩增。这些发现拓宽了LRP12相关疾病的临床谱，并支持在遗传学未明确的成人起病下运动神经元综合征评估中纳入LRP12重复扩增分析。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近将LRP12 CGG重复扩增与成人起病非5q型SMA联系起来，并提示其应纳入ALS相关下运动神经元综合征的遗传评估，具有明确的ALS相关性和转化价值。

items.title: Herbal nanoparticles in the treatment of neurodegeneration: from molecular mechanisms to therapeutic translation.
items.summary: Neurodegenerative diseases (NDDs), including Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, Huntington's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, are characterized by progressive neuronal loss involving multiple pathological mechanisms, including protein aggregation, oxidative stress, neuroinflammation, and mitochondrial dysfunction. Although conventional therapies provide symptomatic relief, they fail to halt disease progression and are limited by poor blood-brain barrier (BBB) penetration, off-target effects, and systemic toxicity. Likewise, several herbal bioactives, such as curcumin, resveratrol, quercetin, and epigallocatechin gallate, exhibit promising neuroprotective properties but suffer from poor aqueous solubility, low oral bioavailability, rapid metabolism, and inadequate brain delivery. Nanotechnology-based delivery systems have emerged as a promising approach to overcome these pharmacokinetic limitations by enhancing stability, controlled release, BBB transport, and brain accumulation of herbal therapeutics. This review critically summarizes recent advances in herbal nanoformulations, emphasizing disease-specific molecular targets, BBB-targeting strategies, comparative nanocarrier systems, pharmacokinetic optimization, intracellular trafficking, and translational challenges. Unlike previous reviews, it integrates recent evidence on nanotoxicology, manufacturing scalability, quality control, regulatory considerations, and emerging technologies, including biomimetic nanoparticles and extracellular vesicles. Despite encouraging preclinical outcomes, clinical evidence remains limited, and no herbal nanoformulation has yet demonstrated definitive efficacy or received regulatory approval for neurodegenerative diseases. Future clinical translation will require standardized formulations, rigorous safety evaluation, and well-designed clinical trials. Unlike previous reviews that primarily summarize individual nanocarrier systems or herbal therapeutics, the present review provides a comprehensive and critical synthesis of the current evidence by integrating disease-specific molecular mechanisms, herbal bioactives, nanocarrier design strategies, blood-brain barrier transport mechanisms, intracellular trafficking, pharmacokinetic considerations, translational barriers, regulatory challenges, clinical evidence, and emerging technologies. Furthermore, the review identifies major knowledge gaps and future research priorities to facilitate the successful clinical translation of herbal nanoformulations for neurodegenerative disorders. The online version contains supplementary material available at https://doi.org/10.1007/s13205-026-05048-8.

items.titleZh: 草药纳米颗粒治疗神经退行性疾病：从分子机制到治疗转化
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述，系统梳理了草药纳米制剂用于神经退行性疾病（含ALS）的研究进展。文章指出，姜黄素、白藜芦醇等草药成分虽有神经保护潜力，但存在溶解性差、生物利用度低、难以入脑等问题；纳米递送系统可改善稳定性、控释和血脑屏障穿透。综述还讨论了疾病特异性靶点、纳米载体设计、药代动力学、纳米毒理、生产放大、质控和监管等转化障碍。核心结论是：临床前证据令人鼓舞，但临床证据有限，目前尚无草药纳米制剂在神经退行性疾病中证实明确疗效或获批。
items.insight: 对ALS研究者而言，这篇综述的价值在于把“草药活性成分+纳米递送”这一相对分散的领域，按疾病机制、血脑屏障转运、细胞内转运和转化瓶颈进行了系统整合。ALS治疗长期受限于入脑递送和靶点异质性，纳米载体若能与神经炎症、线粒体功能障碍、蛋白稳态等ALS相关机制结合，可能提供组合干预思路。但文章明确提醒，当前仍停留在临床前阶段，尚无临床疗效验证，因此更适合作为立项和转化路径设计的参考，而非临床决策依据。

items.abstractZh: 神经退行性疾病（NDDs），包括阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、亨廷顿病和肌萎缩侧索硬化，其特征是进行性神经元丢失，涉及多种病理机制，包括蛋白质聚集、氧化应激、神经炎症和线粒体功能障碍。尽管常规疗法可提供症状缓解，但无法阻止疾病进展，并受限于血脑屏障（BBB）穿透性差、脱靶效应和全身毒性。同样，几种草药生物活性成分，如姜黄素、白藜芦醇、槲皮素和表没食子儿茶素没食子酸酯，表现出有前景的神经保护特性，但存在水溶性差、口服生物利用度低、代谢迅速和脑内递送不足的问题。基于纳米技术的递送系统已成为克服这些药代动力学限制的有前景方法，通过增强草药治疗剂的稳定性、控释、BBB转运和脑内蓄积。本综述批判性地总结了草药纳米制剂的最新进展，强调疾病特异性分子靶点、BBB靶向策略、比较纳米载体系统、药代动力学优化、细胞内转运和转化挑战。与既往综述不同，它整合了关于纳米毒理学、制造可扩展性、质量控制、监管考虑以及新兴技术（包括仿生纳米颗粒和细胞外囊泡）的最新证据。尽管临床前结果令人鼓舞，但临床证据仍然有限，尚无草药纳米制剂在神经退行性疾病中显示出明确疗效或获得监管批准。未来的临床转化需要标准化制剂、严格的安全性评估和精心设计的临床试验。与主要总结单个纳米载体系统或草药治疗剂的既往综述不同，本综述通过整合疾病特异性分子机制、草药生物活性成分、纳米载体设计策略、血脑屏障转运机制、细胞内转运、药代动力学考虑、转化障碍、监管挑战、临床证据和新兴技术，提供了当前证据的全面而批判性的综合。此外，本综述确定了主要知识空白和未来研究重点，以促进草药纳米制剂用于神经退行性疾病的成功临床转化。在线版本包含补充材料，网址为 https://doi.org/10.1007/s13205-026-05048-8。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述新近整合了仿生纳米颗粒和细胞外囊泡等新兴递送技术，并直接讨论ALS等神经退行性疾病的血脑屏障递送与转化瓶颈，对评估纳米治疗策略的临床转化前景具有参考价值。

items.title: Artificial Intelligence in Neuromuscular Diseases: Opportunities for a Data-Scarce Field.
items.summary: Neuromuscular diseases (NMDs) encompass over 800 distinct entities affecting approximately one in 1000 individuals worldwide, with progressive muscle weakness, atrophy, and motor impairment as primary clinical manifestations. The rarity of most NMDs creates fundamental challenges for artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) applications that typically require large-scale datasets. In this narrative review we synthesize the literature published between 2018 and 2025 on AI applications across the NMD spectrum, organized by clinical application domain. We examine how AI has advanced diagnostic capabilities through genetic variant interpretation, muscle magnetic resonance imaging analysis, electromyography-based classification, and computational pathology. In disease monitoring and prognosis, wearable-derived digital biomarkers have achieved regulatory qualification (US Food and Drug Administration [FDA] and European Medicines Agency [EMA]) as clinical trial endpoints for Duchenne muscular dystrophy, while AI-driven survival models for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) have been validated across 14 European centers. Proteomic and multi-omics analyses using ML have identified diagnostic panels for ALS. However, most reported models were developed and internally validated on single-center datasets, and few have undergone external or prospective validation or clinical implementation. Despite these achievements, research intensity varies dramatically across NMD subtypes, with ALS and Duchenne muscular dystrophy dominating while myotonic dystrophy, congenital myopathies, and metabolic myopathies remain virtually unexplored. Critical gaps persist in computational pathology, multi-center validation, and clinical translation. In this review, we discuss how federated learning, international collaborative networks (TREAT-NMD, Solve-RD, EURO-NMD), and foundation models can address these challenges, and propose directions for future AI-enhanced clinical studies in this data-scarce field.
items.titleZh: 人工智能在神经肌肉疾病中的应用：一个数据稀缺领域的机遇
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇2026年发表的叙述性综述，系统梳理了2018至2025年间人工智能在神经肌肉疾病中的应用。文章指出，ALS和杜氏肌营养不良症是AI研究最集中的两个病种：ALS方面，AI驱动的生存模型已在14个欧洲中心完成验证，基于机器学习的蛋白质组学和多组学分析也识别出了ALS诊断标志物组合；杜氏肌营养不良症方面，可穿戴设备衍生的数字生物标志物已获FDA和EMA认可作为临床试验终点。但文章同时强调，绝大多数模型仅在单中心数据上开发和内部验证，缺乏外部验证和临床落地，且强直性肌营养不良、先天性肌病等病种几乎无人问津。作者提出联邦学习、国际协作网络和基础模型是突破数据稀缺瓶颈的潜在路径。
items.insight: 这篇综述对ALS研究者有两层价值。第一，它明确指出了ALS在神经肌肉疾病AI研究中已处于领先位置——14中心验证的生存模型和ML衍生的蛋白质组诊断组合是当前最接近临床转化的成果，值得作为方法学参照。第二，它揭示了整个领域从单中心内部验证向多中心外部验证和临床实施过渡的结构性瓶颈，这对正在设计ALS数字生物标志物或AI预后模型的研究者具有直接的策略指导意义：数据共享架构（联邦学习）和国际协作网络的选择将决定研究能否跨越转化鸿沟。

items.abstractZh: 神经肌肉疾病（NMDs）涵盖800多种不同的疾病实体，全球约每1000人中就有1人受累，主要临床表现为进行性肌无力、萎缩和运动障碍。大多数NMDs的罕见性给通常需要大规模数据集的人工智能（AI）和机器学习（ML）应用带来了根本性挑战。在这篇叙述性综述中，我们按临床应用领域组织，综合了2018年至2025年间发表的关于AI在NMD谱系中应用的文献。我们考察了AI如何通过遗传变异解读、肌肉磁共振成像分析、基于肌电图的分类和计算病理学推进诊断能力。在疾病监测和预后方面，可穿戴设备衍生的数字生物标志物已获得监管资格认定（美国食品药品监督管理局[FDA]和欧洲药品管理局[EMA]），成为杜氏肌营养不良症的临床试验终点，而针对肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）的AI驱动生存模型已在14个欧洲中心得到验证。使用ML的蛋白质组学和多组学分析已识别出ALS的诊断组合标志物。然而，大多数已报告的模型是在单中心数据集上开发和内部验证的，很少有模型经过外部或前瞻性验证或临床实施。尽管取得了这些成就，不同NMD亚型的研究强度差异巨大，ALS和杜氏肌营养不良症占主导地位，而强直性肌营养不良、先天性肌病和代谢性肌病几乎未被探索。在计算病理学、多中心验证和临床转化方面仍存在关键差距。在这篇综述中，我们讨论了联邦学习、国际合作网络（TREAT-NMD、Solve-RD、EURO-NMD）和基础模型如何应对这些挑战，并为这一数据稀缺领域的未来AI增强临床研究提出了方向。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述整合了2018至2025年间AI在神经肌肉疾病中的最新进展，明确将ALS列为研究最集中、验证最充分的病种，并提出了联邦学习和基础模型等解决数据稀缺的转化路径，对ALS领域的AI研究设计具有直接的前沿参考价值。

items.title: Selective targeting of the oligodendroglial GPR17 receptor improves myelin integrity and motor function in female SOD1 G93A mice.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disease with no definitive disease-modifying therapies available, underscoring the urgent need to identify novel druggable targets. The G protein-coupled receptor GPR17 is a critical regulator of oligodendrocyte maturation and has emerged as a candidate target in ALS, yet its relevance to human disease and its therapeutic potential remain unclear. Here, we demonstrate that pathological GPR17 upregulation defines a conserved, pathologically immature oligodendroglial state in human ALS that can be pharmacologically leveraged to restore myelin integrity and improve functional outcome in vivo. Publicly available transcriptomics datasets and histological analyses revealed an increased abundance of GPR17-expressing immature oligodendrocytes in post-mortem human spinal cord tissue from ALS cases. Moreover, sustained activation of GPR17 with a selective agonist induced GPR17 internalization in heterologous expression systems and promoted the differentiation of primary oligodendrocyte precursors derived from SOD1 G93A mice. Translating these findings in vivo, chronic treatment with a brain-penetrant GPR17 agonist derived from the same pharmacological class significantly extended survival, delayed body weight loss, and improved motor performance in female SOD1 G93A mice, whereas male mice showed no therapeutic benefit. These effects were associated with restored oligodendrocyte maturation, preserved myelin integrity, motor neuron survival, and attenuated reactive gliosis in the spinal cord of female SOD1 G93A mice, while milder effects were observed in males. Together, these findings establish oligodendroglial GPR17 as a conserved and pharmacologically actionable target in ALS and show that sustained in vivo GPR17 agonism can reprogram altered oligodendroglial states and slow disease progression in a sex-dependent manner.
items.titleZh: 选择性靶向少突胶质细胞GPR17受体可改善雌性SOD1 G93A小鼠的髓鞘完整性和运动功能
items.summaryZh: 该研究在人类ALS脊髓组织中发现GPR17上调标记了一种病理性未成熟少突胶质细胞状态。在SOD1 G93A小鼠中，使用脑渗透性GPR17激动剂长期治疗可延长雌性小鼠生存期、改善运动功能并保护髓鞘和运动神经元，但雄性小鼠无显著获益。结果提示GPR17是ALS中一个可成药靶点，且疗效具有性别依赖性。
items.insight: 这项研究将人类ALS组织学发现与SOD1 G93A小鼠的体内药理学干预相衔接，首次证明GPR17激动可重编程少突胶质细胞状态并改善疾病结局，为少突胶质细胞靶向治疗提供了临床前概念验证。其性别依赖性效应尤其值得关注，提示未来ALS试验设计需考虑性别分层，并推动GPR17激动剂向临床转化评估。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致命的神经退行性疾病，目前尚无明确的疾病修饰疗法，这凸显了识别新型可成药靶点的迫切需求。G蛋白偶联受体GPR17是少突胶质细胞成熟的关键调节因子，并已成为ALS的候选靶点，但其与人类疾病的相关性及治疗潜力仍不明确。在此，我们证明病理性GPR17上调定义了人类ALS中一种保守的、病理性未成熟少突胶质细胞状态，可通过药理学手段加以利用，以在体内恢复髓鞘完整性并改善功能结局。公开可用的转录组数据集和组织学分析显示，ALS病例死后人脊髓组织中表达GPR17的未成熟少突胶质细胞丰度增加。此外，使用选择性激动剂持续激活GPR17可在异源表达系统中诱导GPR17内化，并促进源自SOD1 G93A小鼠的原代少突胶质前体细胞分化。将这些发现转化至体内，使用源自同一药理学类别的脑渗透性GPR17激动剂进行长期治疗，可显著延长雌性SOD1 G93A小鼠的生存期、延缓体重下降并改善运动表现，而雄性小鼠未显示治疗获益。这些效应与雌性SOD1 G93A小鼠脊髓中少突胶质细胞成熟恢复、髓鞘完整性保留、运动神经元存活及反应性胶质增生减弱相关，而在雄性中观察到的作用较轻微。总之，这些发现确立了少突胶质细胞GPR17作为ALS中一个保守且药理学上可操作的靶点，并表明体内持续GPR17激动可重编程改变的少突胶质细胞状态，并以性别依赖的方式减缓疾病进展。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于人类ALS脊髓组织发现GPR17相关少突胶质细胞病理状态，并在SOD1 G93A小鼠中证明药理学靶向GPR17可改善髓鞘完整性和运动功能，具有明确的ALS转化价值。

items.title: Intrinsically disordered proteins and liquid-liquid phase separation: Molecular grammar, condensate physiology, and disease-relevant phase transitions.
items.summary: Intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) and intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) of proteins constitute a substantial and functionally critical fraction of the eukaryotic proteome. Through multivalent, low-affinity interactions encoded in their low-complexity domains (LCDs), IDPs drive liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS)-a physicochemical process that produces membraneless biomolecular condensates serving as dynamic reaction hubs within cells. Recent advances have substantially refined the conceptual framework governing condensate biophysics: the phase separation coupled to percolation (PSCP) model now recognizes that condensates are viscoelastic network fluids arising from the synergy between density transitions and connectivity (percolation) transitions, rather than simple LLPS alone. This updated mechanistic understanding, combined with proteome-wide computational tools and AI-driven prediction models, is rapidly transforming the field. Physiologically, condensates regulate transcription at super-enhancers, modulate RNA metabolism in stress granules, and orchestrate ribosome biogenesis in the nucleolus. Pathologically, aberrant liquid-to-solid transitions of disease-associated IDPs-including TDP-43 and FUS in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis and frontotemporal dementia, tau in Alzheimer's disease, and α-synuclein in Parkinson's disease-represent a convergent pathomechanism across neurodegenerative proteinopathies. Post-translational modifications, particularly phosphorylation, arginine methylation, and ubiquitination, function as a dynamic regulatory code controlling condensate assembly and dissolution. The emerging paradigm of condensate-modifying therapeutics (c-mods) identifies biomolecular condensates as druggable entities and proposes four mechanistic strategies-dissolvers, inducers, localizers, and morphers-to restore normal phase behavior in disease. This review integrates the most current molecular, cellular, and biomedical insights into IDP-driven phase separation, highlighting open questions and translational opportunities.
items.titleZh: 内在无序蛋白与液-液相分离：分子语法、凝聚体生理学及疾病相关相变
items.summaryZh: 该综述系统梳理了内在无序蛋白通过液-液相分离形成生物分子凝聚体的分子机制、生理功能及病理转变。重点指出TDP-43、FUS等ALS相关蛋白的异常液-固相变是神经退行性疾病的趋同病理机制，并介绍了以凝聚体为靶点的四类治疗策略（溶解剂、诱导剂、定位剂、形态调节剂）。
items.insight: 该综述将ALS相关蛋白TDP-43和FUS的病理聚集置于液-液相分离与相变的统一框架下，提出凝聚体修饰疗法（c-mods）的四类策略，为ALS药物开发提供了从“清除聚集”转向“调控相行为”的新思路。同时整合了PSCP模型和AI预测工具，有助于研究者重新审视TDP-43病理机制及筛选干预靶点。

aiRead.keyFinding: TDP-43和FUS等ALS相关蛋白的异常液-固相变是神经退行性蛋白质病的趋同病理机制；凝聚体修饰疗法（c-mods）提出溶解剂、诱导剂、定位剂和形态调节剂四种策略以恢复正常相行为。
aiRead.limitation: 作为综述，未提供原始实验数据；c-mods策略目前多为概念性框架，缺乏临床验证；PSCP模型和AI预测工具的转化应用仍需实验证实。

items.abstractZh: 内在无序蛋白（IDPs）和蛋白质的内在无序区域（IDRs）构成了真核蛋白质组中一个数量可观且功能关键的部分。通过其低复杂度结构域（LCDs）编码的多价、低亲和力相互作用，IDPs驱动液-液相分离（LLPS）——一种产生无膜生物分子凝聚体的物理化学过程，这些凝聚体在细胞内充当动态反应枢纽。近期进展大幅完善了凝聚体生物物理学的概念框架：相分离耦合渗流（PSCP）模型现已认识到，凝聚体是由密度转变与连接性（渗流）转变协同作用产生的粘弹性网络流体，而非单纯的LLPS。这一更新的机制理解，结合全蛋白质组计算工具和AI驱动的预测模型，正在迅速改变该领域。在生理学上，凝聚体调控超级增强子处的转录、调节应激颗粒中的RNA代谢，并协调核仁中的核糖体生物发生。在病理学上，疾病相关IDPs的异常液-固转变——包括肌萎缩侧索硬化症和额颞叶痴呆中的TDP-43和FUS、阿尔茨海默病中的tau以及帕金森病中的α-突触核蛋白——代表了神经退行性蛋白质病中一种趋同的病理机制。翻译后修饰，特别是磷酸化、精氨酸甲基化和泛素化，作为控制凝聚体组装和解散的动态调控密码发挥作用。凝聚体修饰疗法（c-mods）这一新兴范式将生物分子凝聚体确定为可成药实体，并提出四种机制策略——溶解剂、诱导剂、定位剂和形态调节剂——以恢复疾病中的正常相行为。本综述整合了关于IDP驱动相分离的最新分子、细胞和生物医学见解，强调了开放问题和转化机遇。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述于2026年发表，整合了PSCP模型和AI预测等最新进展，直接关联ALS中TDP-43/FUS的相变病理机制，并提出凝聚体修饰疗法这一新兴转化方向。

items.title: Identity-by-descent to resolve reduced penetrance and advance gene discovery in neurodegenerative disease.
items.summary: Advances in sequencing technologies have transformed human genetics and accelerated disease gene discovery. Yet a causal mutation remains to be identified for many families with an inherited disease. Incomplete penetrance, genetic heterogeneity, and limited family history can complicate the binary classification of familial and sporadic disease. These challenges are amplified in late-onset diseases such as amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and frontotemporal dementia (FTD), where obscured inheritance patterns limit gene discovery opportunities and can confound clinical risk assessment. We evaluated whether identity-by-descent (IBD) analysis can uncover cryptic relatedness and mitigate the impact of incomplete penetrance on disease gene mapping and clinical interpretation. Genome-wide IBD inference was performed in an integrated cross-continent cohort of 3,524 individuals of European ancestry spanning the ALS-FTD neurodegenerative spectrum. IBD identified 793 pairs of 1st-6th degree relatives (siblings to second cousins once removed), of which 31.5% were previously unrecognised and 15.8% had differing clinical diagnoses. Among individuals recorded as "sporadic", 5.5% of ALS and 15.9% of FTD were genetically related to another affected individual in the cohort, demonstrating that reduced penetrance masks a substantial proportion of heritable disease. Affected individuals with known ALS/FTD-associated genetic variants had balanced male-to-female ratios, irrespective of reported family history or IBD-inferred relatedness, whereas those without an identified disease-linked genetic variant retained the expected male predominance in ALS/FTD cohorts. IBD analysis identified multiple cross-continent founder networks for known ALS disease genes, including SOD1 and C9orf72, and created 73 new IBD-defined pedigrees from apparently unrelated probands, providing a framework for disease variant discovery in otherwise underpowered families. Using SOD1 mutation-positive families as a positive-control framework, we demonstrated that IBD-based pedigree expansion retained the known disease locus in distant relatives while reducing genome-wide candidate regions, supporting its application to unresolved ALS/FTD pedigrees. In an IBD-identified extended pedigree comprising five affected individuals, genome-wide variant filtering identified three rare variants within a chromosome 13q21.33 candidate locus shared IBD by four individuals and supported by multipoint linkage analysis. IBD-based detection of cryptic relatedness reveals genetic links between familial and apparent sporadic neurodegenerative disease, helping to resolve penetrance-related inheritance misclassification. By reconstructing extended pedigrees using IBD, this approach strengthens gene discovery and supporting variant pathogenicity while providing clinicians with clearer context for inherited risk and genetic counselling.
items.titleZh: 利用同源同一性解析神经退行性疾病中的不完全外显并推进基因发现
items.summaryZh: 该研究在3524名欧洲血统的ALS-FTD谱系个体中开展全基因组同源同一性（IBD）分析，发现大量此前未被识别的亲缘关系：31.5%的亲属对为既往未知，15.8%的亲属对临床诊断不同。在被归类为“散发性”的患者中，5.5%的ALS和15.9%的FTD患者实际与其他患病个体存在遗传亲缘关系，提示不完全外显导致部分可遗传病例被误判为散发性。IBD分析还识别出SOD1、C9orf72等已知基因的跨大陆奠基者网络，并从看似无关的先证者中重建了73个新家系。以SOD1家系为阳性对照，基于IBD的家系扩展保留了已知位点并缩小了候选区域。在一个IBD识别的扩展家系中，研究者通过变异过滤和连锁分析在13q21.33区域发现三个罕见候选变异。总体而言，IBD方法可揭示隐匿亲缘关系、纠正遗传模式误分类，并增强ALS/FTD的基因发现与变异解读能力。
items.insight: 这项研究为ALS遗传学中长期存在的“散发性”与“家族性”二分法提供了可操作的修正框架。通过IBD推断，研究者证明相当一部分被标记为散发的ALS/FTD病例实际上存在隐匿的遗传亲缘关系，这意味着当前基于家族史的遗传风险评估和基因检测策略可能系统性遗漏了一部分可遗传病例。对于ALS研究者而言，该方法可直接应用于现有队列的重新分析，帮助识别被误分类的家系、扩展统计效力不足的家系以支持罕见变异发现，并为临床遗传咨询提供更准确的复发风险信息。此外，该研究展示的跨大陆奠基者网络和13q21.33候选位点提示，IBD驱动的家系重建可能成为连接已知基因与未解家系之间的桥梁。

aiRead.keyFinding: 在3524名ALS-FTD谱系个体中，IBD分析揭示31.5%的亲属关系此前未被识别，5.5%的散发性ALS和15.9%的散发性FTD患者实际与其他患病个体存在遗传亲缘关系，表明不完全外显导致大量可遗传病例被误分类为散发性。

aiRead.watchNext: 后续需关注该团队是否将IBD框架应用于非欧洲人群队列，以及13q21.33候选位点的功能验证和更多未解ALS/FTD家系中基于IBD的变异发现结果。

items.abstractZh: 测序技术的进步改变了人类遗传学并加速了疾病基因的发现。然而，对于许多患有遗传性疾病的家族而言，致病突变仍有待确定。不完全外显、遗传异质性以及有限的家族史可使家族性与散发性疾病的二元分类变得复杂。这些挑战在肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）和额颞叶痴呆（FTD）等晚发性疾病中被放大，因为被掩盖的遗传模式限制了基因发现的机会，并可能干扰临床风险评估。我们评估了同源同一性（IBD）分析能否揭示隐匿的亲缘关系，并减轻不完全外显对疾病基因定位和临床解读的影响。在一个涵盖ALS-FTD神经退行性疾病谱系、由3524名欧洲血统个体组成的跨大陆整合队列中进行了全基因组IBD推断。IBD识别出793对一至六级亲属（同胞至二级堂表亲的子女），其中31.5%此前未被识别，15.8%具有不同的临床诊断。在被记录为“散发性”的个体中，5.5%的ALS和15.9%的FTD患者与队列中另一名患病个体存在遗传亲缘关系，表明不完全外显掩盖了相当比例的可遗传疾病。携带已知ALS/FTD相关遗传变异的患病个体，无论报告的家族史或IBD推断的亲缘关系如何，男女比例均平衡；而未发现疾病相关遗传变异的个体则保留了ALS/FTD队列中预期的男性优势。IBD分析识别出已知ALS疾病基因（包括SOD1和C9orf72）的多个跨大陆奠基者网络，并从看似无关的先证者中创建了73个新的IBD定义家系，为在原本统计效力不足的家系中进行疾病变异发现提供了框架。以SOD1突变阳性家系作为阳性对照框架，我们证明基于IBD的家系扩展在远亲中保留了已知疾病位点，同时缩小了全基因组候选区域，支持其应用于未解决的ALS/FTD家系。在一个由五名患病个体组成的IBD识别扩展家系中，全基因组变异过滤在染色体13q21.33候选位点内识别出三个罕见变异，由四名个体共享IBD，并得到多点连锁分析的支持。基于IBD的隐匿亲缘关系检测揭示了家族性与表观散发性神经退行性疾病之间的遗传联系，有助于解决与外显率相关的遗传模式误分类。通过利用IBD重建扩展家系，该方法增强了基因发现并支持变异致病性判定，同时为临床医生提供了关于遗传风险和遗传咨询的更清晰背景。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究利用大规模跨大陆队列的IBD分析，新近揭示了不完全外显如何掩盖ALS/FTD的可遗传性，并为基因发现和临床遗传风险评估提供了可直接转化的家系重建框架。

items.title: Integrative synaptosome multi-omics reveals disrupted synapse organization and localized cryptic transcripts in C9ORF72-frontotemporal dementia.
items.summary: Frontotemporal dementia (FTD) and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) are linked neurodegenerative diseases characterized by both synaptic dysfunction and TDP-43 pathology. A hexanucleotide repeat expansion (HRE) in the C9ORF72 (C9) gene represents the most common genetic cause of FTD and ALS, yet the synapse-specific mechanisms underlying disease pathogenesis remain poorly understood. Here, we performed integrated multi-omic profiling of synaptosomes enriched from postmortem frontal cortex and patient-derived induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC)-cortical neurons to define molecular alterations associated with C9-FTD-mediated synaptic dysfunction. Proteomic profiling of frontal cortex-derived synaptosomes identified 1,324 differentially abundant proteins (p<0.05) enriched in pathways regulating synaptic vesicle transport and synapse organization, while synaptosomal RNA sequencing revealed 2,835 differentially expressed protein-coding genes. C9-FTD iPSC-cortical neurons exhibited reductions in excitatory and inhibitory postsynaptic markers, accompanied by progressive impairment of neuronal network activity, supporting both structural and functional deficits. iPSC-derived synaptosomes recapitulated key molecular pathways observed in patient brain, revealing convergent dysregulation of synaptic signaling pathways. Comparative analyses revealed divergence between protein and RNA alterations, consistent with the disruption of regulatory processes that link RNA and protein abundance in diseased synapses. Consistent with TDP-43 loss-of-function pathology we identified cryptic exon (CE)-containing transcripts within C9-FTD frontal cortex-derived synaptosomes, including KALRN and STMN2, providing evidence that aberrantly spliced RNAs localize to synaptic compartments. Together, these findings define convergent molecular pathways underlying synapse vulnerability in both C9-FTD model systems and identify synaptic localization of CE-containing transcripts as a previously unrecognized feature of TDP-43 proteinopathy.
items.titleZh: 整合性突触体多组学揭示C9ORF72-额颞叶痴呆中突触组织破坏及局部隐蔽转录本
items.summaryZh: 该研究对C9ORF72相关FTD患者脑组织及iPSC来源皮层神经元的突触体进行多组学分析，发现突触蛋白和RNA表达广泛紊乱，突触信号通路趋同失调，且携带隐蔽外显子的异常剪接转录本（如KALRN、STMN2）可定位于突触体，提示TDP-43功能丧失导致的RNA剪接异常可能直接损害突触。
items.insight: 该研究将C9ORF72-FTD的突触病理与TDP-43功能丧失导致的隐蔽外显子剪接异常直接联系起来，并首次在突触体水平检测到含隐蔽外显子的转录本，为理解ALS/FTD中突触选择性脆弱性提供了新视角，也为开发针对突触区室RNA代谢异常的干预策略提供了潜在靶点。

aiRead.keyFinding: C9-FTD突触体存在广泛的蛋白质和RNA表达紊乱，突触信号通路趋同失调；含隐蔽外显子的异常剪接转录本（KALRN、STMN2）定位于突触体，提示TDP-43功能丧失病理直接累及突触区室。

items.abstractZh: 额颞叶痴呆（FTD）和肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是相关的神经退行性疾病，以突触功能障碍和TDP-43病理为特征。C9ORF72（C9）基因中的六核苷酸重复扩增（HRE）是FTD和ALS最常见的遗传病因，但疾病发病机制中突触特异性机制仍知之甚少。本研究对来自死后额叶皮层和患者来源诱导多能干细胞（iPSC）皮层神经元的突触体进行了整合多组学分析，以定义与C9-FTD介导的突触功能障碍相关的分子改变。额叶皮层来源突触体的蛋白质组学分析鉴定出1,324个差异丰度蛋白（p<0.05），富集于调节突触囊泡运输和突触组织的通路，而突触体RNA测序揭示了2,835个差异表达的蛋白编码基因。C9-FTD iPSC皮层神经元表现出兴奋性和抑制性突触后标志物减少，伴随神经元网络活动的进行性损害，支持结构和功能缺陷。iPSC来源的突触体重现了患者大脑中观察到的关键分子通路，揭示了突触信号通路的趋同失调。比较分析揭示了蛋白质和RNA改变之间的差异，与疾病突触中连接RNA和蛋白质丰度的调节过程破坏一致。与TDP-43功能丧失病理一致，我们在C9-FTD额叶皮层来源的突触体中鉴定出含有隐蔽外显子（CE）的转录本，包括KALRN和STMN2，提供了异常剪接RNA定位于突触区室的证据。总之，这些发现定义了C9-FTD模型系统和患者中突触脆弱性的趋同分子通路，并确定了含CE转录本的突触定位是TDP-43蛋白病的一个先前未被认识的特征。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究于2026年发表，首次在C9ORF72-FTD患者脑组织和iPSC模型突触体中鉴定出TDP-43功能丧失相关的隐蔽外显子转录本，将突触功能障碍与RNA剪接异常直接关联，具有重要的ALS转化研究价值。

items.title: A Qualitative Study of Team-Based Serious Illness Communication in ALS.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a terminal neurodegenerative disease with an illness trajectory requiring repeated, high-stakes decisions and ongoing serious illness communication (SIC). While multidisciplinary team care is best practice in ALS, how interprofessional teams operationalize SIC, and how team culture shapes this work, remain poorly understood. To examine how team culture influences SIC delivery within an interprofessional ALS clinic. We conducted a qualitative study using semi-structured interviews and a focus group with interprofessional clinicians from a multidisciplinary ALS clinic at an academic medical center. Data explored clinicians' perceptions of interprofessional roles, team culture, facilitators, and barriers related to SIC. Transcripts were analyzed using thematic analysis with a combined deductive-inductive approach. Analysis identified interpersonal facilitators, systems-level facilitators, and structural barriers shaping team-based SIC. Clinicians described shared responsibility for SIC, with conversations unfolding cumulatively over time across roles and clinical encounters. Interpersonal facilitators included mutual respect, psychological safety, role flexibility, and a shared commitment to reducing patient harm. Systems-level facilitators included frequent multimodal communication, structured documentation, leadership support, and use of adverse outcomes as opportunities for practice improvement. Structural barriers included time constraints, care transitions, regulatory limitations, and variability in comfort with SIC language. In this multidisciplinary ALS clinic, strong team culture enabled SIC to function as a longitudinal, interprofessional process rather than a single clinician-led event. Findings highlight the importance of psychological safety, teamwork, and supportive systems in delivering high-quality SIC and inform future clinical practice, training, and research.

items.titleZh: ALS中基于团队的严重疾病沟通的定性研究
items.summaryZh: 这项定性研究访谈了某学术医学中心多学科ALS诊所的跨专业临床医生，探讨团队文化如何影响严重疾病沟通（SIC）。研究发现，强大的团队文化使SIC成为贯穿不同角色和就诊的纵向跨专业过程，而非单次由某位医生主导的谈话。人际促进因素包括相互尊重、心理安全感、角色灵活性和减少伤害的共同承诺；系统层面促进因素包括多模式沟通、结构化文档和领导支持；结构性障碍包括时间限制、照护转衔和监管限制。
items.insight: ALS照护高度依赖多学科团队，而严重疾病沟通的质量直接影响患者决策、照护目标和临终体验。这项研究提供了团队文化如何塑造SIC的机制性理解，提示ALS研究者与临床团队在评估沟通干预或照护模式时，应将心理安全感、角色灵活性和系统支持纳入考量，而非仅关注单个临床医生的沟通技能。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种终末期神经退行性疾病，其疾病轨迹需要反复做出高风险决策并持续进行严重疾病沟通（SIC）。尽管多学科团队照护是ALS的最佳实践，但跨专业团队如何实施SIC，以及团队文化如何塑造这项工作，仍知之甚少。旨在考察团队文化如何影响跨专业ALS诊所内的SIC实施。我们开展了一项定性研究，对某学术医学中心多学科ALS诊所的跨专业临床医生进行了半结构化访谈和一次焦点小组讨论。数据探讨了临床医生对跨专业角色、团队文化、SIC相关促进因素和障碍的看法。转录文本采用结合演绎-归纳方法的主题分析进行分析。分析识别出塑造基于团队SIC的人际促进因素、系统层面促进因素和结构性障碍。临床医生描述了SIC的共同责任，对话随着时间推移在不同角色和临床接触中累积展开。人际促进因素包括相互尊重、心理安全感、角色灵活性以及减少患者伤害的共同承诺。系统层面促进因素包括频繁的多模式沟通、结构化文档、领导支持以及将不良结局作为实践改进的机会。结构性障碍包括时间限制、照护转衔、监管限制以及对SIC语言舒适度的差异。在该多学科ALS诊所中，强大的团队文化使SIC能够作为纵向的跨专业过程发挥作用，而非单一临床医生主导的事件。研究结果强调了心理安全感、团队合作和支持性系统在提供高质量SIC中的重要性，并为未来临床实践、培训和研究提供信息。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究聚焦ALS多学科团队中严重疾病沟通的实施机制，为优化以团队为基础的ALS照护模式提供了新近的定性证据。

items.title: Dysregulation of mitochondrial bioenergetics, RNA processing, and cellular stress responses in FUS-ALS: a multi-dataset transcriptomic perspective.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder characterized by motor neuron (MN) degeneration. Mutations in the FUS gene, particularly the aggressive P525L variant, disrupt nuclear localization of the FUS RNA-binding protein, resulting in cytoplasmic accumulation, altered RNA metabolism, and toxic aggregation. Astrocytes also contribute to disease progression through non-cell-autonomous mechanisms. To identify shared and cell-type-specific molecular mechanisms underlying FUS-associated ALS through integrated transcriptomic analysis of human induced pluripotent stem cell (hiPSC)-derived motor neurons and astrocytes. Five publicly available RNA-sequencing datasets from hiPSC-derived motor neurons and astrocytes carrying FUS mutations were analyzed. Differential gene expression and Gene Ontology enrichment analyses were performed to identify dysregulated genes and pathways. Both cell types showed convergent dysregulation of mitochondrial/bioenergetic pathways (oxidative phosphorylation, ATP metabolism, translation, membrane potential). Pathway analysis across motor neuron datasets identified largely MN-specific enrichment in cell-cycle regulation, intracellular trafficking, and stimulus response, while only four pathways were shared with astrocytes, most notably NADH dehydrogenase complex assembly, enriched across all datasets and both cell types, marking mitochondrial complex I as the strongest convergent signature. RNA processing/splicing pathways were also enriched, consistent with FUS function. Shared DEGs included upregulated COMT, TXNRD2, and PCDHGB4, and downregulated PCDH17 and C11orf87, implicating neurotransmitter metabolism, antioxidant defenses, and adhesion. Stress pathways (oxidative stress, autophagy, heat-shock, ER stress/UPR) were broadly altered, with UPR genes mainly upregulated and inflammatory genes downregulated. FUS-ALS involves shared mitochondrial complex I and stress-response disturbances layered onto MN-intrinsic cell-cycle and trafficking dysregulation, reflecting convergent and cell-type-specific mechanisms.
items.titleZh: FUS-ALS中线粒体生物能量学、RNA加工和细胞应激反应的失调：多数据集转录组学视角
items.summaryZh: 该研究通过整合五个公开的hiPSC来源运动神经元和星形胶质细胞RNA测序数据集，发现FUS-ALS中两种细胞类型均存在线粒体复合体I组装和应激反应的趋同失调，而运动神经元还表现出特有的细胞周期和细胞内运输异常。共享差异基因涉及神经递质代谢、抗氧化和细胞黏附。
items.insight: 该研究利用多数据集整合分析，揭示了FUS-ALS中线粒体复合体I是跨细胞类型的最强趋同分子特征，并区分了运动神经元固有与星形胶质细胞共享的病理通路，为理解FUS突变非细胞自主机制和开发靶向线粒体功能障碍的干预策略提供了转录组学依据。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种以运动神经元（MN）退化为特征的进行性神经退行性疾病。FUS基因突变，尤其是侵袭性P525L变异，破坏FUS RNA结合蛋白的核定位，导致细胞质积聚、RNA代谢改变和毒性聚集。星形胶质细胞也通过非细胞自主机制促进疾病进展。通过整合分析人诱导多能干细胞（hiPSC）来源的运动神经元和星形胶质细胞的转录组学，识别FUS相关ALS的共享和细胞类型特异性分子机制。分析了五个公开可用的RNA测序数据集，这些数据集来自携带FUS突变的hiPSC来源运动神经元和星形胶质细胞。进行了差异基因表达和基因本体富集分析，以识别失调基因和通路。两种细胞类型均显示线粒体/生物能量通路的趋同失调（氧化磷酸化、ATP代谢、翻译、膜电位）。跨运动神经元数据集的通路分析主要识别出MN特异性的细胞周期调控、细胞内运输和刺激反应富集，而仅四条通路与星形胶质细胞共享，最显著的是NADH脱氢酶复合体组装，在所有数据集和两种细胞类型中均富集，标志着线粒体复合体I是最强的趋同特征。RNA加工/剪接通路也富集，与FUS功能一致。共享差异表达基因包括上调的COMT、TXNRD2和PCDHGB4，以及下调的PCDH17和C11orf87，涉及神经递质代谢、抗氧化防御和黏附。应激通路（氧化应激、自噬、热休克、ER应激/UPR）广泛改变，UPR基因主要上调，炎症基因下调。FUS-ALS涉及共享的线粒体复合体I和应激反应紊乱，叠加在MN固有的细胞周期和运输失调之上，反映了趋同和细胞类型特异性机制。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究通过多数据集转录组整合，新近揭示了FUS-ALS中线粒体复合体I和应激反应在运动神经元与星形胶质细胞间的趋同失调，为ALS转化研究提供了细胞类型特异性的分子靶点线索。

items.title: Natural history of 441 cases of bulbar onset motor neuron disease (MND) in China: a single-center retrospective study.
items.summary: To describe the natural history and identify prognostic factors of bulbar onset motor neuron disease (MND). Bulbar onset MND patients with regular follow-up between January 2014 and December 2023 were included. Clinical features at initial evaluation, duration from onset to next region and time to death or tracheotomy were retrospectively collected. Survival analysis was performed by Kaplan-Meier method and Cox regression model. A total of 441 patients were included. Disease progression occurred most frequently from bulbar region to upper limbs (77.1%), followed by lower limbs (16.4%) and respiratory muscles (6.5%), with a median time interval of 6.0 (1.0, 48.0) months. 215 patients died or underwent tracheotomy. The median duration to death or tracheotomy was 43.0 (95% CI 39.1-46.9) months, the 1-year, 2-year, 3-year, 4-year and 5-year survival rates (95%CI) were 96.6% (94.9-98.3), 79.9% (76.0-83.9%), 59.1% (54.0-64.7), 42.2% (36.6-48.6) and 29.9% (24.3-36.7), respectively. Younger onset age, slower ALSFRS-R decreasing rate, longer diagnostic delay, longer duration to next region and pure upper motor neuron involvement at initial evaluation were associated with favorable prognosis. Upper limbs involvement secondly to bulbar region was independently associated with better outcomes compared with respiratory muscles spreading. The natural history of bulbar-onset ALS exhibits substantial heterogeneity. Patients with only upper motor neuron involvement in bulbar region at onset and subsequent upper limbs involvement as the second region tend to have a favorable prognosis.
items.titleZh: 中国441例延髓起病型运动神经元病（MND）的自然史：一项单中心回顾性研究
items.summaryZh: 这项单中心回顾性研究分析了441例中国延髓起病型MND患者的自然史。中位至死亡或气管切开时间为43.0个月，5年生存率约29.9%。疾病最常从延髓区域扩散至上肢（77.1%），中位间隔6.0个月。起病年龄较轻、ALSFRS-R下降较慢、诊断延迟较长、至下一区域时间较长、初诊时单纯上运动神经元受累提示预后较好；延髓后累及上肢者预后优于累及呼吸肌者。
items.insight: 该研究提供了中国人群延髓起病型MND较大样本的自然史数据，明确了扩散模式和预后分层因素，有助于临床咨询、试验分层和终点选择。尤其是“延髓后第二区域为上肢 vs 呼吸肌”的独立预后差异，提示扩散路径可作为预后标志物或富集标准，值得在生物标志物和临床试验设计中进一步验证。

items.abstractZh: 描述延髓起病型运动神经元病（MND）的自然史并识别预后因素。纳入2014年1月至2023年12月期间接受规律随访的延髓起病型MND患者。回顾性收集初诊时的临床特征、从起病到累及下一区域的时间以及至死亡或气管切开的时间。采用Kaplan-Meier法进行生存分析，并采用Cox回归模型。共纳入441例患者。疾病进展最常从延髓区域累及上肢（77.1%），其次为下肢（16.4%）和呼吸肌（6.5%），中位时间间隔为6.0（1.0，48.0）个月。215例患者死亡或接受气管切开。至死亡或气管切开的中位时间为43.0（95% CI 39.1-46.9）个月，1年、2年、3年、4年和5年生存率（95%CI）分别为96.6%（94.9-98.3）、79.9%（76.0-83.9%）、59.1%（54.0-64.7）、42.2%（36.6-48.6）和29.9%（24.3-36.7）。起病年龄较轻、ALSFRS-R下降速度较慢、诊断延迟较长、至累及下一区域时间较长以及初诊时单纯上运动神经元受累与较好的预后相关。与呼吸肌扩散相比，延髓区域之后累及上肢与更好的结局独立相关。延髓起病型ALS的自然史表现出显著的异质性。起病时延髓区域仅累及上运动神经元、且随后第二个受累区域为上肢的患者往往预后较好。
items.frontierRationale: 基于中国单中心441例延髓起病型MND的近期自然史数据，揭示了扩散路径相关的预后异质性，对ALS临床试验分层和预后标志物开发具有转化价值。
